subject: Request to bridge pilot access while procurement finalizes
messages:
From: Alex Rodriguez <alex@healthbridge.co>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot access — procurement delayed, ask for temporary support

Hi Mina,

Quick update from our side — the pilot is going well, but procurement put the PO on hold pending updated liability language. Legal and procurement are reconciling points and expect a decision in ~10 business days.

We’re at the point where our engineers need another week of steady access to finish the final evaluation (batch runs tomorrow). Would Redwood be able to provide a short bridge (tokens/credits or extended trial window) while procurement finalizes? We’d like to avoid losing momentum.

I can loop procurement if you need formal confirmation. Thanks for any flexibility here.

— Alex
Alex Rodriguez
Director of AI Engineering | HealthBridge Therapeutics
alex@healthbridge.co
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rodriguez <alex@healthbridge.co>
Cc: PrIyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access — procurement delayed, ask for temporary support

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the heads up and for the clear timeline. Good to hear the pilot traction. We can absolutely help keep the environment live while procurement closes the loop. To keep things straightforward, I propose: 

- A one-week bridge of sandbox credits (equivalent to $2,500 of usage) to maintain uninterrupted access.
- If procurement expects longer than 7 business days, we can extend to 14 business days with an approval from your procurement contact.

Can you please:
1) Share the procurement contact email (or loop them in).
2) Confirm the PO ETA (even an approximate date).
3) Tell us if your team needs any extra quotas or a short spike for batch runs.

I’m copying Priyom (sales finance) to fast-track approvals and Vanessa (CS) to make sure the runtime configuration is preserved during the bridge. We typically send a short confirmation doc and provision the credits once procurement acknowledges the ETA.

If that works, I’ll prepare the credit grant and a 1-line confirmation for your procurement team.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: Pilot_Usage_Summary.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: procurement@healthbridge.co
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Alex Rodriguez <alex@healthbridge.co>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access — procurement delayed, ask for temporary support

Hi Mina —

Thanks for reaching out. I’m Carmen Diaz from HealthBridge procurement. Apologies for the delay — we’re finalizing the liability addendum and expect sign-off by 2027-03-22.

We appreciate the offer of bridge credits. For internal approval I need a short written confirmation from Redwood that:
- The bridge credit is a temporary, goodwill provision and does not modify contract terms.
- Usage during the bridge will be billed if the final contract is not executed within 30 days after the PO sign date.

Please send a short one-line confirmation we can include in our approval ticket. Also attach your quote so we can record the expected spend against the PO.

Regards,
Carmen Diaz
Senior Procurement Manager
HealthBridge Therapeutics
procurement@healthbridge.co

Attachment: (none)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Carmen Diaz <procurement@healthbridge.co>, Alex Rodriguez <alex@healthbridge.co>
Cc: PrIyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access — procurement delayed, ask for temporary support

Hi Carmen —

Thanks for the clarity and for the timeline. Confirming in writing for your approval ticket:  

Redwood Inference will provision a one-week, $2,500 temporary credit to HealthBridge’s pilot account as a goodwill measure to preserve proof-of-concept continuity. This provision is temporary and does not amend or replace any contractual obligations; if a commercial agreement is not executed within 30 days after PO signature, usage during the bridge period will be billed per Redwood’s standard terms.

We’ve attached the formal quote you requested (Redwood_Quote_HealthBridge_03102027.pdf). Once you confirm the PO ETA on 2027-03-22 we’ll apply the credits within 4 business hours and notify Alex.

Priyom — please confirm the credit grant in HubSpot and mark the line item as a temporary uplift tied to DL-9847. Vanessa — standby to preserve the pilot cluster and raise quotas for the batch tomorrow.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that helps speed approvals.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
